summary: Atmus Filtration Technologies filed an 8-K on November 6, 2026, reporting third-quarter 2026 results (Item 2.02) and disclosing that its board approved a new $300 million share repurchase authorization, effective immediately, replacing the prior program that had $28.9 million remaining. Repurchases may occur via open market or privately negotiated transactions, including Rule 10b5-1 plans, funded from operating cash flow and cash on hand; no expiration date, no obligation, suspendable at any time. No price, premium, or advisor named. Watch pace of buybacks versus leverage and any accelerated execution signals.
